commercial_building_character: Anchored by Westfield Doncaster, a well-known major shopping complex built 1969 at Doncaster and Williamsons Roads; a significant retail centre serving Melbourne's east.
verbatim_source_quotes: In 1969, Westfield Doncaster was built on the corner of Doncaster and Williamsons Roads and is a well-known shopping complex in Melbourne.
